statement_summary: One group program meeting each division's rule; the written program for Tax and Advisory
Group CISO is Qualified Individual; affiliate conditions in 314.4(a)(1)-(3)
Annual written risk assessment per unit with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Units document common control inheritance; written intercompany agreements with security and notice terms
IRC 7216: no disclosure or use without a permission or prior written consent; other group entities are separate persons
Sanctions for policy violations and misuse of tax return information
Service provider review, contract terms, and periodic assessment; 7216 contractor notices; Practice Cloud sub-processor gate
Annual assessment by internal audit; Qualified Individual's annual written report
Exceptions risk-rated and time-limited; MFA exceptions need Qualified Individual approval
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Unique identities; shared mailboxes by delegation only
Role-based least privilege; office-scoped access in SYS-T1
No access before background check and training
MFA for every individual; legacy authentication blocked; exceptions need Qualified Individual approval
Service accounts owned, governed, workload identity or 90-day rotation
Disable within 4 hours of termination; seasonal accounts end on the HR end date
Quarterly certification; monthly for seasonal access in season
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM
MFA for client portals and Practice Cloud administrators; step-up for Wealth money movement
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour, including unexplained MFA prompts and bank-change requests
One group severity scale and playbooks
Record discovery, confirmation, awareness, and determination dates per entity
Each regulated entity makes its own notice decision and documents it
Combined notification matrix owned by Group General Counsel; reviewed quarterly
Affiliate notices on the bridge and within the shortest contract or regulatory period
Severity 1 to disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality
Hold refunds, payroll changes, and transfers until verified
Annual cross-division exercise with the matrix and a materiality decision
Encrypt Restricted information; deliver returns through the portal
Tax return information leaves Tax and Advisory only through interfaces that check a recorded, specific consent
Statistical compilations only as 301.7216-2(o) allows
Immutable separate-provider backups with quarterly restore tests
Retention schedule; disposal within the rule; quarterly purge verification
No Restricted information in AI tools without approval, no-training and U.S.-only terms, and a confirmed legal basis
Training before access and every year; quarterly phishing including bank-change requests
Call-back to a number of record before any bank, address, or transfer change
Restricted information only on managed devices; Wealth communications in archived channels
Approved AI tools only; practitioners responsible for AI-assisted work
Office intake mailboxes retired; delegation only; no legacy authentication or forwarding until then
IRS Stakeholder Liaison report by the next business day after confirmation
Holding company acts as subcontractor for PHI only under business associate terms
Affiliate service providers in due diligence and 72-hour notice terms
AI meeting summaries archived as records before expansion
AI and sub-processor change gate (privacy, 7216, contracts, SOC 2 description)
Isolation tests in every release; independent test each year
